# Existing Patterns {.section-title time="20"}

## Lead and List

:::medium
A paper joins a **conversation among scholars** [@huff1999writing].
:::

:::incremental
- Conversations take place in journals and at conferences.
- They define which questions count as interesting.
- Only some ideas lead to further discussion.
:::

## Quote {.no-headline .vertically-centered .bg-highlight}

:::large
> Imagine that you enter a parlor. You come late. When you arrive, others have long preceded you. *@burke1941philosophy*
:::

# New Elements {.section-title time="40"}

## Split Layout {.split}

:::kicker
Positioning
:::

:::lead
The split layout gives the heading its own column, which suits slides with one claim and several supporting points.
:::

- **Conversation fit:** the outlet publishes your debate.
- **Genre fit:** it publishes your type of paper.
- **Level fit:** the ranking matches your contribution.

## Statement {.statement}

Reviewers judge a manuscript by the conversation it joins.

## Key Figures

:::stats
:::stat
3–5

exemplar papers to model before you draft
:::

:::stat
15 min

editor reading time before a desk decision
:::

:::stat
1–2 yrs

typical review cycle at a top journal
:::
:::

## Three Constructions

:::cells
:::cell
**Synthesized coherence**

Connects work that was not previously cited together.
:::

:::cell
**Progressive coherence**

Presents a line of cumulative research.
:::

:::cell
**Non-coherence**

Presents competing positions in the field.
:::
:::

## Accent Slide {.accent-slide}

:::medium
Reserve full-bleed color for **one moment per section.**
:::

## Ink Slide {.ink-slide}

:::lead
Dark surfaces suit [transitions]{.highlight} and summaries.
:::

1. Discussions keep their black background.
2. Ink slides reuse the same surface for new content.

## Exercise {.unlisted .unnumbered .html-hidden .discussion-slide}

:::medium
Outlet shortlist
:::

Work in pairs and complete two steps:

1. Select **three outlets** from your conversation map.
2. Note each outlet's **ranking** and **paper category**.

## Condensed Slide

:::: html-hidden
Upload your manuscript package by **Monday, 07.12.2026:**

:::incremental
1. **Manuscript:** full draft, including the discussion
2. **Positioning sheet:** one page, from the template
:::
::::

:::notes
The slide shows a condensed version inside `:::: html-hidden`; the HTML wiki shows this full text from `:::notes` instead.

1. **Manuscript:** a full draft of one paper you are working on, including at least a draft of the discussion section. Name the file with your full name first.
2. **Positioning sheet (one page):** discipline, association and subgroup, literature strand, conversation, target outlet, and one sentence stating your intended contribution.
:::
